plan: The dominant strategy in this auction game is to bid your private value, as it maximizes expected profit regardless of other bids. Since my private value is $31, I will bid exactly $31. This approach balances the potential profit from winning against the cost of potentially overbidding and ensures I don't pay more than my value.

The dominant strategy in this auction game is to bid my value, which is $46. This strategy maximizes my expected profit because if I win, I pay the second-highest bid and gain the difference between my value and that bid. Since this is a single round with no history to consider, I will follow this strategy to optimize my profit potential.

The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid your private value for the prize, as this maximizes expected profit. Since my private value for this item is $35, I will bid exactly $35. This strategy is optimal because it ensures that I win the item only if the second-highest bid is less than or equal to my value, thus securing a profit.
